text.arabic_uthmani: وَمَنْ أَرَادَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ وَسَعَىٰ لَهَا سَعْيَهَا وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌۭ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ كَانَ سَعْيُهُم مَّشْكُورًۭا

baseline.text: Kim ahireti ister, inanmış olarak onun için gerektiği gibi çaba gösterirse işte onların çabası karşılık görür.

findings.text: Ahirete yönelen çabanın ona uygun olması, amacı kendi temposuna ve emeğine bağlı bir çalışma düzenine dönüştürür; karşılık görmesi de bu emeğin görünür ve verimli kılınmasıdır.

activation_trace.role: Volitional inclination supplies the initiating orientation toward the named end.
Active seeking converts an inward wish into a quest for what is sought.
The later or other-than-first horizon supplies the quest's temporal destination.
Purposeful movement toward a sought object gives the threefold root a directed trajectory.
Intentional work and earning make the trajectory practical rather than merely aspirational.
The split mapping's unattended wandering supplies a negative edge: the possessive construction rules out motion left to go wherever it will.

changed_reading.after: Let the later end set both the direction and proper form of the work; the verse tests whether enacted movement fits the end it claims to desire.
changed_reading.before: Want the Hereafter and make an effort for it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence `أَرَادَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ وَسَعَىٰ لَهَا سَعْيَهَا` joins a named end, dative orientation, and a repeated root whose second noun is possessed by that end.
baseline_models.mechanism: Intention initiates a quest, but the Hereafter governs the direction and fitting form of the work. The split inventory also exposes aimless drifting as the failure mode excluded by `لها سعيها`, so the criterion is congruence rather than exertion in the abstract.

activation_trace.role: Deferral to a later time supplies the temporal pressure under which trust must operate.
Directed movement supplies the ongoing activity held inside the believing state.
Settled security and trust supply steadiness while the desired end remains unseen and later.
Heart-level assent supplies confidence in the claim that makes present work for a deferred end intelligible.

changed_reading.after: Faith is the settled, promise-trusting state in which a deferred course can remain directed and coherent.
changed_reading.before: Faith is an eligibility condition added alongside effort.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The circumstantial clause `وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ` accompanies the striving rather than appearing only as a separate result.
baseline_models.mechanism: The believer's settled security and assent to a trusted claim form the operating state of delayed, future-directed labor. Faith stabilizes the course and is not merely an additional credential checked after the work.

activation_trace.role: Work and earned action identify the thing that receives the final predicate.
Occurrence in time gives the appreciation the force of an established status rather than a bare wish.
Recognition of received good supplies the relational acknowledgment placed upon the labor.

changed_reading.after: Their striving itself comes to stand as recognized; the process is not erased behind whatever recompense follows.
changed_reading.before: The qualified people will receive a reward.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: In `كَانَ سَعْيُهُم مَّشْكُورًا`, the striving itself, rather than only the agent or a payout, bears the passive predicate.
baseline_models.mechanism: The final clause gives the labor a realized status of recognition. Appreciation preserves the value and addressability of the work itself instead of translating the whole clause into an impersonal wage.

activation_trace.role: Obedient service supplies the relational posture in which the earlier gratitude is enacted.
The servant's active recognition of beneficence establishes the outgoing half of the reciprocal pattern.
The community's enacted work becomes the patient upon which returning acknowledgment settles.
Passive recognition supplies the returning half of the relation and attaches it to the effort.

changed_reading.after: The grateful servant supplies a relational template: gratitude enacted through service returns as acknowledgment borne by the striving itself.
changed_reading.before: `مشكورا` is a one-way formula for reward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier grateful servant and the later thanked striving reverse the direction of the same root. Gratitude first moves from servant toward giver, then acknowledgment returns and adheres to the servant-community's work.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated frame and active-to-passive reversal; I infer a reciprocal gratitude circuit, while the live alternative is that the two predicates are independent uses of the same root.
structural_cues: 17:3 and 17:19 repeat a `كَانَ` plus ش ك ر predicate while switching from `شَكُورًا` as an agent-quality to `مَشْكُورًا` as a patient-quality.
The earlier predicate belongs to a servant; the later predicate belongs to the plural group's striving.

activation_trace.role: Restoration toward a prior position supplies recovery after displacement.
A renewed round supplies repetition rather than a single irreversible pass.
Paired return after departure supplies the reciprocal cycle that can be re-entered.
Habitual recurrence converts repeated return into a maintained practice rather than accidental repetition.
The split mapping's back-and-forth hesitation supplies the instability that a proper course must organize.
Repeated purposeful movement turns return into resumed progress toward the same end.

changed_reading.after: Proper striving can be a repeatable course that resumes after reversal; what is acknowledged is sustained re-entry, not a fiction of uninterrupted motion.
changed_reading.before: Proper striving is a single linear push without interruption.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context's returns, renewed turn, and paired `if you return, We return` change striving from one uninterrupted advance into a repeatable practice of re-entry after reversal. The split ر و د inventory makes oscillation visible, while the focus's threefold س ع ي gives recurrence a stable course.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies historical cycles and lexical recurrence; I infer that proper striving includes resumption and repair, while the live alternative is that the returns describe collective history without specifying an individual's practice.
structural_cues: 17:6-8 clusters return language before the focus, including an explicit conditional recurrence.
17:19 repeats س ع ي as verb, cognate object, and final subject, allowing the course to persist across episodes.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward a true path supplies direction external to the striver's preference.
Upright balance supplies a criterion for judging whether movement is well aligned.
Purposive action supplies the concrete work through which guidance becomes embodied.
Suitability to a thing supplies the qualitative fit encoded by the possessive `its striving`.
Directed movement receives its route from the contextual guidance and upright measure.
Assent links the focus believer to the guided believers whose actions instantiate the fit.

changed_reading.after: `Its striving` is work whose direction, balance, and fitness answer to guidance; volume cannot substitute for alignment.
changed_reading.before: `Its striving` means a sufficient quantity of sincere exertion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance toward what is most upright, followed by believers doing fitting works, resolves `سعيها` as normed labor. The desired end does not license a self-designed route; guidance supplies direction, uprightness supplies measure, and صلاح supplies fitness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies guidance, uprightness, believing workers, and fitting action; I infer that these specify the quality of `سعيها`, while the live alternative is that 17:9 merely parallels rather than defines the focus criterion.
structural_cues: 17:9 sequences guidance, believers, fitting actions, and recompense; 17:19 sequences desire, object-fitted striving, believer, and appreciation.
The root ء م ن recurs in both sequences, making the earlier action profile available to the focus.

activation_trace.role: A call that can bring down harm supplies the concrete possibility that desire misidentifies its own good.
Inclination toward benefit supplies the intended good against which the harmful call is miscalibrated.
Premature acceleration supplies the cognitive-temporal cause of the miscalibration.
Repeated willing in the immediate-seeker clause shows that wanting does not command what is actually granted.
The immediate and its hastening supply the direct temporal counterform to the focus's later end.
Unhurried pacing gives the focus intention a discipline opposed to premature acceleration.
Acceptance of a later time prevents immediate delivery from becoming the test of truth.
Fitting work becomes the external test that keeps inward desire from authenticating itself.

changed_reading.after: Wanting is fallible under haste; the later horizon, its fitting work, and settled belief jointly test whether the desire is rightly formed.
changed_reading.before: An intense or sincere wish for the right object is self-validating.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hasty human can call for harm as though calling for good, and the seeker of the immediate wants an accelerated result still bounded by divine will. Against that failure, 17:19 makes desire answer to a later horizon, its fitting course, and a believing state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies harmful prayer, haste, and paired desires; I infer that `سعيها` is a temporal-ethical correction to fallible wanting, while the live alternative is that the pair contrasts destinations without diagnosing desire itself.
structural_cues: 17:18 and 17:19 are paired `من` clauses with repeated ر و د but opposed objects: the immediate and the Hereafter.
17:18 separates the seeker's will from `what We will for whom We will`; 17:19 inserts `لها سعيها` before the outcome.

activation_trace.role: Binding a judgment to its bearer supplies durable personal attachment between action and agent.
Composed writing supplies a stable medium in which the course can remain legible.
An opened written record supplies public readability rather than hidden or vanished action.
Reckoning supplies the operation that reads the preserved particulars back to the self.
The enacted course supplies the content retained in the contextual record.
Recognition supplies the positive address made possible once the labor remains legible.

changed_reading.after: The course leaves an attached, readable trace; being thanked means the effort itself survives as recognized evidence, even where visible results do not disclose its value.
changed_reading.before: Only the achieved result matters, and the process disappears once it ends.

context_deltas.mechanism: The attached account, extracted book, opened writing, and self-accounting make action durable and inspectable. This changes `سعيهم مشكورا` from praise of a final outcome into recognition of a preserved course whose details remain addressable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an attached readable account and reckoning; I infer that appreciation preserves and recognizes the process, while the live alternative is that the record concerns judgment generally without specifying what `مشكورا` adds.
structural_cues: 17:13 moves from something attached to the person to a produced, opened book; 17:14 commands the person to read and account.
17:19 makes `سعيهم`, not merely the people, the grammatical bearer of appreciation.

activation_trace.role: The immediate seeker's volition identifies the first of the two groups resumed by `these and those`.
Accelerated present receipt supplies the tempting but unreliable visible sign of approval.
Connected increase and support supply provision that is explicitly extended to both groups.
Bestowal supplies the shared source of what each group presently receives.
The negation of barring removes restricted access to provision as an acceptance test.
The particular work, rather than its worldly yield, remains the object under evaluation.
Relational acknowledgment supplies the value-marker that universal provision cannot by itself reveal.

changed_reading.after: Present gift supports both orientations; `مشكورا` is a distinct recognition of the work and cannot be inferred directly from worldly supply.
changed_reading.before: Present abundance or successful output can be read as evidence that a striving is appreciated.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate-seeker and the Hereafter-seeker are both extended from the Lord's gift, so worldly supply cannot discriminate which striving is appreciated. `مشكورا` names a valuation distinct from the visible distribution that reaches both orientations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies provision extended as gift to both orientations; I infer that material expansion is not an acceptance marker, while the live alternative is that the shared gift may differ in kind even if its source is universal.
structural_cues: 17:20's `كُلًّا ... هَؤُلَاءِ وَهَؤُلَاءِ` resumes the two opposed seekers of 17:18-19 and gives both an extension.
Only 17:19 predicates `مشكورا` of striving, while 17:20 predicates unrestricted gift across both groups.

activation_trace.role: Directed inspection supplies an explicit invitation to compare the differentiated pattern.
Differential rank supplies a value scale rather than a single undivided outcome.
Greater magnitude expands that scale specifically in the later field.
Movement degree by degree supplies the stepwise geometry applied to the focus course.
The later end anchors the differentiated field directly in the focus object.
Purposeful movement supplies the course capable of traversing differentiated degrees.

changed_reading.after: Acknowledged striving opens onto a differentiated, stepwise field; proper effort can have larger degrees without losing the common criterion of fit.
changed_reading.before: The verse sets a binary threshold: qualifying effort either reaches one undifferentiated accepted state or does not.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to inspect differentiated ranks, followed by the Hereafter's larger degrees, turns the desired end from a single terminal point into a vertically differentiated field. Purposeful striving can therefore be read as a stepwise course whose appreciation is not merely binary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies larger degrees and stepwise ascent; I infer that `سعيها` can unfold as a graded course, while the live alternative is that the degrees rank final stations without describing stages or evaluations of striving.
structural_cues: 17:21 immediately follows the paired seekers and repeats `الآخرة` before naming larger degrees and differentiation.
The focus repeats the movement root three times; the next verse supplies an explicitly graded spatial-value structure.

activation_trace.role: Directed worship supplies the dependency whose division produces the closing failure state.
Withdrawal from action supplies the exact kinetic opposite of purposeful striving.
Inability to rise turns the result into sustained arrest rather than a momentary pause.
Weakening legs supplies the bodily image of support failing beneath the course.
Undivided security and trust supply the stabilizing countercondition to failed dependency.
Purposeful movement supplies the live course that divided reliance threatens to arrest.

changed_reading.after: Believing trust is also an anti-arrest condition: undivided reliance keeps the course mobile, while rival dependency ends in unsupported inability to continue.
changed_reading.before: `وهو مؤمن` is only a doctrinal modifier attached to otherwise self-powered effort.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing prohibition places rival worship on a causal path to sitting and loss of support. Read backward, the focus believer's undivided trust is not only doctrinal qualification but the configuration that keeps purposeful movement from collapsing into arrested dependence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies worship, cessation of action, inability to rise, and weakened support; I infer that undivided faith sustains motion, while the live alternative is that `فتقعد` is an idiom of condemned status rather than a kinetic commentary on striving.
structural_cues: 17:19 centers repeated motion; 17:22 ends its causal prohibition with `فَتَقْعُدَ`, a result-state of sitting.
The intervening verses move through extension, comparison, and degrees before the final warning against unsupported arrest.

remaining_uncertainties: The reciprocal gratitude circuit is strongly cued by form and sequence but remains a reader-supplied directional inference.
`سعيها` may encode qualitative fit, due measure, or both; the packet does not force a single relation.
The account-and-book sequence may preserve all deeds for judgment without specifically defining the force of `مشكورا`.
The growth and self-release readings should remain contained lexical analogies rather than controlling interpretations.
strongest_changes: `سعيها` became an object-governed and guided criterion of fit rather than an unspecified quantity of exertion.
The 17:3 to 17:19 ش ك ر reversal made appreciation reciprocal and attached the returning recognition to the work itself.
17:11 and the paired 17:18 clause made desire fallible under haste, so faith and fitting labor calibrate rather than merely accompany it.
The readable account of 17:13-14 and universal gift of 17:20 separated durable recognition from visible worldly output.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sits inside unusually dense reversals: grateful servant versus thanked striving, immediate desire versus the later end, personal work versus universal provision, motion versus final sitting, and a singular `whoever` whose acknowledged striving forms a plural class.

activation_trace.role: Stable, increasing good supplies a contextual growth environment for the focus's appreciated work.
Connected augmentation supplies the continuing input by which an initial effort can be extended.
Actual work supplies the seed-like input rather than a merely verbal wish.
A small provision whose effect becomes evident supplies the image of disproportionate responsiveness.
Fresh offshoots supply the image of acknowledged effort continuing beyond its initial act.

changed_reading.after: Appreciated striving can be pictured as receptive growth: a genuine input becomes manifest, is extended, and sends out effects beyond the initiating act.
changed_reading.before: Appreciation is chiefly verbal commendation or a later payment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates growth-response branches of ش ك ر rather than ordinary verbal gratitude. It remains anchored in `مشكورا`, whose inventory includes slight input showing visible effect and fresh shoots, while contextual growing good and connected increase reinforce the material analogy. Render it as a lexical image of receptive amplification, not a promise that every small act produces visible worldly growth.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The passive `مَّشْكُورًا` is predicated of the threefold striving, allowing the work itself to be pictured as responsive material.

activation_trace.role: A judgment fastened to its bearer supplies the encumbrance from which the analogy begins.
The literal neck supplies the bodily attachment point that makes the release image concrete.
A heavy load that no substitute bears supplies nontransferable personal liability.
Labor toward one's release supplies the emancipation mechanism applied analogically to the accountable course.
Acknowledgment supplies the positive reception of that liberation-directed labor.

changed_reading.after: Each person labors toward release from an attached, nontransferable account, and the release-directed labor itself is acknowledged.
changed_reading.before: Striving accumulates merit in a general sense.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the technical self-purchase branch of س ع ي and joins it to the nearby neck-bound record and nontransferable burden. It remains valid as a cross-domain mechanism anchored in the focus root and explicit contextual anatomy and liability. Render it only as an emancipation analogy for accountable effort, not as a claim that the verse establishes a literal manumission transaction.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated `سعي` carries an inventory branch in which labor earns release, while the focus makes that labor the object of acknowledgment.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Deferred aim requires its fitting gait, whose small effects are made visible.** Tripled `س ع ي:B001/B002` makes purposeful movement and work; `ء م ن:B001/B002` adds settled trust; `ش ك ر:B001/B002` recognizes favor and shows the effect of little. Repetition binds the sought future to “its” proper striving, unlike hurried desire in 17:18. I infer trust sustains a temporally fitting practice, and acknowledgment makes that practice's value manifest. *Mashkūr* reads as effort rendered visibly fruitful, not only verbally thanked.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:79's extra night-practice leading toward a praised station supplies a concrete instance of “its fitting striving”: repeated self-rousing corresponds to the deferred aim.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Striving as end-matched productive labor.** Lexical evidence: `س ع ي B002` (work, earning, and active endeavor) in the threefold `سَعَىٰ ... سَعْيَهَا ... سَعْيُهُم`, and `ش ك ر B001` (recognizing a favor and praising the benefactor) in passive `مَّشْكُورًا`. Structural cue: 17:18 offers accelerated receipt, 17:20 supplies both groups, and 17:21 distinguishes degrees and preference. Assigned role: repeated `سعي` makes the desired end require its proper work; `مشكور` marks that work as recognized rather than lost in undifferentiated provision. Abductive move: the possessive `سَعْيَهَا` supplies fit between end and effort; I infer that this fit is why the work receives acknowledgment. Reading change: willing the hereafter becomes a disciplined production process whose labor is specifically recognized, in contrast to merely receiving the immediate.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:20–21 corrected any equation of acknowledgment with material receipt: both groups receive supply, while striving is separately recognized and ranks remain differentiated.

words.gloss_range: opening conjunction that coordinates this ayah with the prior immediate-desire panel
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) makes 17:19 a joined counter-panel to 17:18. The ayah does not restart with an unrelated case; it answers the prior immediate-desire condition with a second conditional alternative. Its first payoff is therefore boundary logic: the reader must compare the two panels before isolating either one.

topics.headline: paired boundary coordination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 17:19 as the coordinated alternative to 17:18, not as a detached new topic.
topics.reason: The opening conjunction links this conditional to the prior immediate-desire conditional, making the two ayahs a paired contrast.

words.gloss_range: conditional whoever opening an unrestricted class whose clauses govern desire, effort, and trust
words.prose: {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) opens the rule to whoever fulfills the whole condition. It makes the following perfect verbs generic within the conditional frame, not merely past biography, and it lets desire, striving, and the believing state all remain under one scope. The singular form keeps responsibility individual until the result later expands the qualified agents into a plural class.

topics.headline: open conditional scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that all three qualifications belong to one open conditional rule.
topics.reason: The conditional particle governs the protasis through the verbal conditions and the circumstantial state before the consequence arrives.

topics.headline: individual condition becomes class outcome
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees individual accountability becoming a collective verdict only at the result.
topics.reason: The invariable singular-facing conditional keeps the class open, while the apodosis later resolves it with a plural demonstrative.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect verb of willing, locally selecting deliberate orientation toward its direct object
words.prose: {{ar:أَرَادَ}} ({{tr:arāda}}) is the first content action of the positive panel. Its hidden subject routes back to the conditional person, and its direct object makes the final reality the chosen aim of will. The perfect form also answers the prior imperfect desire in 17:18 with settled resolve. The r-w-d seeking image and Form IV shape add purposive direction, while local syntax keeps the selected sense at deliberate willing, not literal roaming or self-engineered desire. Within the same-surah will thread, human willing here is set beside divine willing at 17:16 and the prior immediate-desire verb at 17:18, but the local subject remains the human conditional agent.
words.root_gloss_range: seeking, going after, wanting, and intending; locally narrowed to purposeful volition rather than wandering search or semantic meaning

topics.headline: will takes the final reality as object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees intention as an aimed act with a selected object, not as a vague inner wish.
topics.reason: The verb has an implicit conditional subject and governs the following object directly, so volition is locally transitive and aimed.

topics.headline: perfect resolve contrasts prior ongoing desire
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the grammatical contrast between ongoing immediate desire in 17:18 and settled hereafter resolve in 17:19.
topics.reason: The paired boundary uses the same desire field with different aspect and object, making the contrast formal as well as semantic.

topics.headline: root seeking becomes purposeful willing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears desire as directed pursuit, while the local clause still selects willing rather than literal movement.
topics.reason: The root and Form IV evidence support purposive orientation, but the direct-object construction narrows the active sense to intentional willing.

topics.headline: same-surah will thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this human willing set beside divine willing at 17:16 and immediate desire at 17:18, while not equating human agency with divine willing.
topics.reason: Same-surah recurrence, especially divine willing at 17:16 and immediate desire at 17:18, makes will a local thread, but it supplies resonance rather than changing the local parse.

words.gloss_range: definite feminine accusative object of will, later resumed by feminine pronouns as goal and standard
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ}} ({{tr:al-ākhirata}}) is the definite object selected by will. Its feminine singular form is not incidental, because the later pronouns point back to it as both the goal of striving and the possessor of the striving measure. Across the 17:18 boundary, the word completes the opposition between immediate gain and deferred final reality. Within Surah 17, the same finality field recurs at 17:7, 17:10, 17:72, and 17:104, so this object belongs to a wider local meditation on what comes after.
words.root_gloss_range: coming after, being delayed, and finality; locally the known deferred final reality opposed to immediacy

topics.headline: objecthood and pronoun continuity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final reality carried from the object of will into the later goal and measure pronouns.
topics.reason: Accusative objecthood and feminine agreement keep the same referent active across the desire and striving clauses.

topics.headline: deferred finality against immediacy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the positive panel is structured by a temporal-value opposition with 17:18.
topics.reason: The local boundary selects the deferred-final sense and opposes it to the immediate orientation in 17:18.

topics.headline: the final reality supplies its own standard
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the desired final reality not only as an aim but as the standard that defines fitting effort.
topics.reason: The later suffixed effort noun lets this referent function as the possessor and measure of the required striving.

topics.headline: Surah 17 finality thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader places this occurrence inside Surah 17’s repeated contrast between immediate perception and final outcome.
topics.reason: Same-surah recurrence at 17:7, 17:10, 17:72, and 17:104 supports a local thematic thread without overriding the immediate syntax.

words.gloss_range: inner coordinating conjunction adding striving as a second requirement inside the same condition
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) inside the protasis adds action to desire. It does not let willing the final reality complete the condition by itself; it joins the effort verb to the will verb as a cumulative requirement. The attached form keeps the second verb visibly inside the same conditional frame.

topics.headline: striving added to intention
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that intention and action are cumulative requirements, not alternatives.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the second verbal clause with the first inside the same conditional protasis.

words.gloss_range: Form I perfect verb of striving, locally directed through the following purpose-goal phrase
words.prose: {{ar:سَعَىٰ}} ({{tr:saʿā}}) turns the desired object into enacted pursuit. The verb is perfect under the conditional, so it states qualifying effort within the open rule, and it reaches its goal through the following prepositional phrase rather than by seizing a direct object. Its s-ʿ-y field keeps motion and labor together: the effort is path-like work. The same root can be misdirected elsewhere, as in 2:114, so the ayah’s value lies in its direction toward the final reality and in the threefold local effort chain that will become an evaluated noun at the end.
words.root_gloss_range: walking, hastening, working, managing, and exerting; locally purposeful labor toward the final reality

topics.headline: conditional effort directed by a goal phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees effort as an enacted condition aimed through a goal phrase, not as a free-standing virtue.
topics.reason: The perfect verb remains conditional under the particle, while the following prepositional phrase supplies the directed goal.

topics.headline: motion and labor remain fused
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels striving as embodied movement and labor, not as intention alone.
topics.reason: The s-ʿ-y evidence supports walking, hastening, and work together, and the local goal phrase selects purposeful exertion.

topics.headline: direction determines the value of striving
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that effort is not automatically praised; its direction decides its outcome.
topics.reason: The same verb can appear in destructive pursuit at 2:114, while here the direction is toward the final reality.

topics.headline: first step in the threefold effort arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears this first effort word launch the local chain: act, measure, then evaluated effort.
topics.reason: This is the first of three local s-ʿ-y occurrences, setting up the later measure and final evaluated subject.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking striving as toward, for, and for the sake of the final reality
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) makes the effort relational before the measure is named. It keeps the final reality from becoming a direct object that the striver controls; the effort is for it, toward it, and calibrated for its sake. Because the phrase comes before the cognate measure, the goal is fixed before the ayah defines the proper kind of striving.

topics.headline: purpose and benefit in the goal phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees striving as oriented for the final reality, not as possession of it.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the pronoun and marks purpose, direction, and benefactive orientation after the effort verb.

topics.headline: goal fixed before effort measure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the goal is named before the proper measure of effort is specified.
topics.reason: The bound prepositional unit stands between the verb and cognate accusative, establishing target before measure.

words.gloss_range: bound feminine pronoun governed by the purpose preposition and referring back to the final reality
words.prose: {{ar:هَا}} ({{tr:hā}}) is a governed suffix, not a new discourse subject. It routes the striving phrase back to the final reality as goal and beneficiary. Its first appearance identifies the target before the same feminine reference returns in the effort-measure word, so the reader tracks one referent through goal and standard.

topics.headline: bound pronoun returns to the final reality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the striving aimed at the same final reality introduced as the object of will.
topics.reason: The suffix is governed by the preposition and agrees with the earlier feminine object, preserving referent continuity.

topics.headline: target named before measure returns
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the target identified first, then heard again as the standard of effort.
topics.reason: The first suffix occurs in the goal phrase before the second suffix appears in the cognate measure.

words.gloss_range: suffixed verbal noun functioning as cognate accusative, specifying the proper measure of striving
words.prose: {{ar:سَعْيَهَا}} ({{tr:saʿyahā}}) is not simple repetition after the effort verb. As a cognate verbal noun, it specifies the kind and measure of striving required. Its feminine suffix makes that measure belong to the final reality: the goal is also the standard. This middle s-ʿ-y occurrence turns action into calibration before the final occurrence becomes the people’s evaluated effort.
words.root_gloss_range: effort, walking, work, and exertion; locally converted into the standard of striving belonging to the final reality

topics.headline: cognate accusative specifies proper striving
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that not any effort qualifies; the effort must match the proper measure.
topics.reason: The verbal noun repeats the root in an accusative cognate function, specifying mode and measure rather than adding a second finite act.

topics.headline: the goal owns the standard
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final reality defines the effort due to it.
topics.reason: The suffixed form ties the effort noun to the feminine referent, allowing possessive and objective pressure around the same standard.

topics.headline: middle link in effort arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the local effort chain from action to standard to final evaluation.
topics.reason: The second s-ʿ-y occurrence prepares the final thanked-effort formula by converting the first act into a measured standard.

words.gloss_range: circumstantial conjunction introducing the believing state that accompanies the striving condition
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) before the pronoun is circumstantial. It does not simply add a third event after willing and striving; it embeds a state alongside them. The result is that trust qualifies the action while it is being described, rather than arriving as a later label.

topics.headline: trust embedded as circumstance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belief is the concurrent state of the striver, not a later add-on.
topics.reason: The connector introduces a circumstantial nominal clause tied to the same conditional agent.

words.gloss_range: independent pronoun anchoring the circumstantial nominal clause to the same singular agent
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) gives the circumstantial clause an overt subject. The same conditional person who wills and strives is now explicitly presented in a state of trust. Because the clause is nominal, the trust is framed as a standing condition of the striver before the apodosis turns the individual into a plural class.

topics.headline: overt pronoun preserves the same agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the believing state attached to the same individual agent who willed and strove.
topics.reason: The independent pronoun serves as the subject of the nominal circumstantial clause and refers back to the conditional agent.

topics.headline: trust presented as standing state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees trust as a state accompanying striving, not as another finite action in sequence.
topics.reason: The verbless clause predicates the following quality as a state rather than adding another action verb.

words.gloss_range: indefinite active participle predicate naming the trust-state that qualifies the conditional agent
words.prose: {{ar:مُؤْمِنٌ}} ({{tr:muʾminun}}) completes the tripartite condition as a state, not a third finite verb. Its agreement keeps the predicate attached to the singular conditional agent, and its indefinite participial form classifies that agent by a quality of trust. The ʾ-m-n field brings security and trust into the condition, but local predication selects believing trust rather than making the person the direct creator of security. The pairing of trust with effort also recalls 21:94, where effort with the same believing-state frame is not denied.
words.root_gloss_range: safety, security, trust, and belief; locally a believing/trusting state rather than a separate act of granting security

topics.headline: participial predicate gives stable state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees belief as the standing quality that qualifies the striving agent.
topics.reason: The nominative active participle is predicate of the pronoun and agrees with the singular conditional agent.

topics.headline: trust and security field colors the predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belief carries trust and security pressure, while the local clause still predicates believing trust.
topics.reason: The root and Form IV evidence support a trust-security field, but the nominal predicate here identifies the striver’s believing state rather than a separate causative action.

topics.headline: trusted effort has a recognition parallel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a wider Quranic pattern in which effort accompanied by believing trust is protected from loss.
topics.reason: The effort-plus-believing-state pattern in 21:94 provides a concrete parallel for the local accepted-effort frame.

words.gloss_range: consequence particle marking the shift from fulfilled conditions to evaluated outcome
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) closes the protasis and opens the result. After desire, calibrated effort, and trust have been set in place, this particle makes the next phrase a consequence rather than another description. Because it attaches to the demonstrative, classification itself becomes the first movement of the outcome.

topics.headline: conditional result hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader knows exactly where the conditions end and the evaluated outcome begins.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the apodosis of the conditional and gives the following classification result force.

topics.headline: faith-result inversion with 17:10
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the faith condition in 17:19 as an explicit positive counterpart to denial and punishment in 17:10.
topics.reason: The same surah contrasts denied faith and punishment at 17:10 with believing trust and appreciated effort here.

words.gloss_range: distal plural demonstrative identifying the fulfilled conditional agents as a pointed class
words.prose: {{ar:أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ}} ({{tr:ulāʾika}}) turns the singular conditional person into a pointed plural class. The result does not begin with the verdict verb; it first identifies those who fulfilled the conditions. Its distance marks distinction rather than physical remoteness, and its extended sound shape gives the class marker weight before the stable verdict follows. The root-family idea of firstness is not the active local sense; demonstrative pointing controls the word here.
words.root_gloss_range: firstness and priority in the root family, but locally suppressed under demonstrative pointing

topics.headline: singular condition becomes plural class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees individual qualification expanded into a recognized collective verdict.

topics.headline: distal pointing marks distinction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the qualified group set apart from the immediate-desire counterpart.
topics.reason: The distal demonstrative marks the group as distinct in the result clause, not physically distant in the scene.

topics.headline: root firstness does not govern the local sense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader avoids importing a priority sense where the local word functions as demonstrative pointing.
topics.reason: The root family can carry firstness, but the local form and syntax function as a demonstrative pronoun.

topics.headline: expanded form gives class marker weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a weighted pause-like class marker before the verdict is stated.
topics.reason: The orthographic and recitational expansion supports audible weight for the demonstrative before the predicate clause.

words.gloss_range: perfect being-verb forming a stable predication of appreciated status rather than a simple past event
words.prose: {{ar:كَانَ}} ({{tr:kāna}}) frames the result as an established state. With the final passive participle, it does not narrate a fresh act of thanking; it declares the effort’s recognized condition. The grammar makes the effort the subject and appreciation the predicate, so the verdict evaluates what their striving has become. The same formula recurs in 76:22, confirming that this is a settled recognition frame, while broader k-w-n standing language only colors the verdict and does not turn it into a spatial claim.
words.root_gloss_range: being, existing, becoming, and standing; locally an established state assigned to the effort

topics.headline: stable state rather than simple past
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees appreciation as an established verdict attached to fulfilled conditions, not as delayed narration.
topics.reason: The perfect being-verb with a participial predicate forms a stative predication in the apodosis.

topics.headline: effort itself is evaluated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause evaluates the effort itself, not only the people.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the effort noun the subject of the being-verb and the final participle its predicate.

topics.headline: closed appreciated-effort formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the ending as part of a paired formula for effort that is accepted rather than lost.
topics.reason: The same being-verb, effort noun, and appreciated predicate recur in the formula at 76:22.

topics.headline: standing language colors the verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear established standing in the verdict while keeping the local sense as stative predication.
topics.reason: The k-w-n family supports being and standing, and the prior desire frame at 17:18 gives the being-verb a local contrast, but local grammar narrows the payoff to established status rather than physical placement.

words.gloss_range: plural-suffixed verbal noun serving as the subject whose effort receives the final predicate
words.prose: {{ar:سَعْيُهُم}} ({{tr:saʿyuhum}}) brings the effort chain into the verdict clause. The plural suffix routes the effort to the demonstrative class, while the verbal noun form lets action stand as a subject that can be evaluated. The earlier standard attached to the final reality has now become their owned effort. The third s-ʿ-y occurrence closes the arc from striving, to proper striving, to effort recognized at the end.
words.root_gloss_range: effort, motion, work, and exertion; locally the owned collective effort ready for evaluation

topics.headline: plural suffix routes effort to the class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the proper striving become the group’s own effort for evaluation.
topics.reason: The plural suffix refers to the demonstrative class and converts the earlier action into their possessed effort.

topics.headline: verbal noun becomes evaluated subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the action has become a stable thing that can carry the final predicate.
topics.reason: The verbal noun is nominative as the subject of the being-verb, so the effort itself receives evaluation.

topics.headline: third effort word completes the arc

words.gloss_range: passive participle predicate characterizing the effort as appreciated, acknowledged, and received
words.prose: {{ar:مَّشْكُورًا}} ({{tr:mashkūran}}) makes appreciated effort the ayah’s landing point. Its agreement ties the predicate to the effort noun, not to the people, and its passive participle form foregrounds the effort as received and acknowledged while leaving the recognizer unnamed in the grammar. The sh-k-r field adds the sense of valued receipt and even fruitful recognition, but those images remain color around the local predicate. As the rare twin of the appreciated-effort formula in 76:22, and as a reversal of the negative ending in 17:18, the final word seals the conditional path with recognition rather than loss. It also returns gratitude language from the grateful-servant wording at 17:3, now reversed into effort being appreciated.
